subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, or may first-run cleanup delete them when the suffix scheme changes?
rationale: Config backups are recovery artifacts and may contain sensitive configuration, so changing shipped retention and cleanup behavior is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision rather than a pure implementation detail.

options.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
options.body: Require the PR to migrate or retain existing numbered backups until the datetime retention set is safely populated, with permissions and tests covering the upgrade path.

options.title: Allow First-Run Pruning
options.body: Accept that upgrading to datetime names may delete existing numbered recovery points in exchange for a clean timestamp-only set.

options.title: Keep The Numbered Ring
options.body: Reject the suffix change for now and keep the shipped numbered backup behavior documented as the stable recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
recommendation.body: Require the PR to migrate or retain existing numbered backups until the datetime retention set is safely populated, with permissions and tests covering the upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent config compatibility and recovery history among the likely owners.
